Toronto Dominion Bk Ont (TD) Holder Bank Of Montreal Has Increased Position Posted by Pete Kolinski 34 pm
Bank Of Montreal increased its stake in Toronto Dominion Bk Ont (TD) by 30444.97% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bank Of Montreal bought 62.96M shares as the company’s stock declined 13.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 63.17M shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $3.84 billion, up from 206,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bank Of Montreal who had been investing in Toronto Dominion Bk Ont for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.92% or $0.45 during the last trading session, reaching $48.31. About 1.28M shares traded. The Toronto-Dominion Bank (NYSE:TD) has declined 8.12% since December 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 8.12% the S&P500.
Bank Of Montreal, which manages about $34.23 billion and $127.66B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (Call) (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.32 million shares to 20,000 shares, valued at $4.52 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in State Str Corp (Put) (NYSE:STT) by 723,480 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 69,100 shares, and cut its stake in Hudbay Minerals Inc (NYSE:HBM).
